briefing.header: Office of the South Dakota Secretary of State
briefing.subject: Voter registration review
briefing.intro: The following rules are in effect for this review.
briefing.no_rules: No rules are in effect for this review.

lines.text: The applicant must be 18 years of age or older on or before the date of the next election.
The date of birth on the identity document, the application form and any citizenship document must agree.
The applicant must list a South Dakota address on the residency declaration.
A residency declaration with no address listed is incomplete.
Tier 1. The applicant presents one of the following original documents. Photocopies are not accepted.
A South Dakota driver license that reads "U.S. Citizen" on the back.
A driver license or nondriver identification card from another state that indicates citizenship has been verified.
A tribal identification card issued by a participating tribe, listed below.
Tier 2. The applicant presents one of the following. Originals and photocopies are accepted.
Consular report of birth abroad issued by the U.S. Department of State.
Expired documents are not accepted. The name on the presented item must match the name on the application.

desk.move_hint: Arrow keys move the focused item. Shift moves it further.

flow.announce_empty: The booth is empty. Press N or the Next applicant button to call an applicant.
flow.announce_stamped_approve: Application {n} stamped APPROVED. Move the form to the Completed forms bin, or press B with the form focused.
flow.announce_stamped_deny: Application {n} stamped DENIED. Move the form to the Completed forms bin, or press B with the form focused.
